text: Two thousand kilometres. As far as its missiles were meant to fly.

text: Inside it... Israel. The Gulf. Every American base in the region.

text: Britain says one failed... and one was shot down. Iran denies firing them.

US intelligence says it could build one by twenty thirty-five... if it decides to.
